title: Mammalian Cell Culture: Refreshing Media
author: Kenneth Schackart
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xqifmue

steps.title: Inspect Cell Culture
steps.instruction: Examine the cells cultured in the T-75 flask using a light microscope to assess culture health, morphology, and check for contamination (e.g., turbidity, bacteria, or pH change indicated by yellowish-orange media).

substeps.instruction: Take an image of the cells for the Results section of the lab report.

steps.title: Remove Old Media
steps.instruction: Remove the old media from the flask using a serological pipette, holding the flask with the lid pointed up to ensure all liquid is removed.

substeps.instruction: Dispose of media in the waste beaker.
Dispose of the pipette tip in the sharps box by sliding it back into its wrapper, ensuring the tip does not touch any surfaces to avoid contamination.

steps.title: Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Wash the cells using warmed DPBS.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 1 mL of warmed DPBS into the flask.
Remove the DPBS and dispose of it into the waste beaker.
Repeat these two actions for a total of 2 washes.

steps.title: Refresh Culture Media
steps.instruction: Pipette 4 mL of warmed cell culture media into the flask.

steps.title: Sterilize and Incubate
steps.instruction: Spray the flask generously with 70% Ethanol solution before placing it in the CO2 incubator.
